fact: Botswana's Minister of Trade and Entrepreneurship told Parliament that the Botswana Bureau of Standards (BOBS) developed national quality standards on school uniforms, which are voluntary; the document gives no date for the body's creation and names no IT or data standard, so it is dated by its publication date.

The Botswana Bureau of Standards (BOBS) publishes a Standardization Annual Work Programme for national standards-development projects, Issue 341 covering 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, updated 16 April 2026; the page names no information technology or data standard.

The Standards Act (Act 16 of 1995, commenced 1 August 1996) establishes the Botswana Bureau of Standards as a body corporate and a Standards Council, and charges the Bureau with preparing and publishing Botswana Standards; it names no information technology or data standard.
